_read_me: One item per FR in docs/Functional_Requirements.md. state is one of not_started | active | passing | blocked. Only a feature's own verification command moving from fail to pass may set state to passing - never edit it directly. WIP = 1: at most one item should be active at a time. evidence is the commit hash once passing.

items.title: Project initialized
items.behavior: init.sh has run: app boots on a connected device to a blank screen, one Jest test passes, make check is green

items.title: Register
items.behavior: User can create an account with email, username, optional phone, password, optional referral code

items.title: Login
items.behavior: User can log in with email-or-username + password; must_change_password routes to FR-105

items.title: Google Sign-In
items.behavior: User can sign in or sign up with Google; server verifies the ID token

items.title: Forgot / reset password
items.behavior: User can request a reset email and set a new password from the reset link

items.title: Forced password change
items.behavior: A must_change_password account can view My eSIMs but is blocked from checkout/wallet until the password is changed

items.title: Resume purchase after login/register
items.behavior: A package + discount code chosen pre-login survives a login/register detour and resumes checkout automatically

items.title: Session restore on app start
items.behavior: A valid stored token silently restores the session on launch; an invalid/expired one falls through to login

items.title: Home / destination search
items.behavior: User can search countries live and see a Popular Destinations grid from the home screen

items.title: Full destination directory
items.behavior: User can browse/search every country, grouped by region

items.title: Country landing (explore) screen
items.behavior: Opening a country shows flag/name/package-count/cheapest-price and the package list

items.title: Package list & filters
items.behavior: User can see package cards (GB/unlimited, validity, price, featured badge) and filter by data size/validity

items.title: Discount code entry (pre-login)
items.behavior: An unauthenticated user can check a discount code and see an estimated saving per package

items.title: Discount code entry (post-login)
items.behavior: A logged-in user sees the exact server-verified discount amount before paying

items.title: Payment method choice
items.behavior: If wallet balance covers the payable amount, user is offered Wallet vs Gateway; otherwise goes straight to gateway

items.title: Wallet checkout
items.behavior: User can pay from wallet balance and reach a success/preparing/error outcome without a false failure on a slow-provisioning order

items.title: Gateway checkout (ShurjoPay)
items.behavior: User can pay via the hosted gateway and the app correctly resumes polling the order on return

items.title: Purchase success
items.behavior: A completed order reveals the branded QR, install links, and a path to My eSIMs

items.title: Purchase still-processing state
items.behavior: A PROCESSING order shows a non-error 'setting up your eSIM' state, never a failure UI

items.title: Purchase failure
items.behavior: Only an explicit FAILED order status shows a failure state, with refund status stated clearly

items.title: eSIM QR component
items.behavior: Renders a QR at error-correction H with a circular 22%-width logo overlay, matching the web/email QR byte-for-byte in settings, and still decodes when the rendered image is cropped/noised

items.title: My eSIMs list
items.behavior: User sees their owned eSIM profiles as cards with tap-to-reveal QR, ICCID, order number, install links, copy LPA, share/print

items.title: eSIM status/detail screen
items.behavior: Shows usage %, status, validity countdown, copyable SM-DP+/matching-ID/LPA, daily usage, install history, and a stale-telemetry warning when relevant

items.title: Printable / shareable receipt
items.behavior: User can render an eSIM/order receipt to PDF and share it

items.title: Copy / share the public tracking link
items.behavior: User can copy or share the share_token tracking URL via the native share sheet

items.title: Public tracking screen
items.behavior: Opening a valid share_token shows the same status view without login; an invalid token shows a clear error with a support link

items.title: Wallet overview
items.behavior: User sees DEFAULT/REWARD/COMMISSION balances and the transaction ledger

items.title: Top-up via gateway
items.behavior: User can top up via ShurjoPay with a preset or custom amount honoring configured limits

items.title: Manual deposit
items.behavior: User can submit a manual deposit (bank/bKash/Nagad/Rocket/QR) with a transaction ID for admin approval

items.title: Top-up result banners
items.behavior: Returning from the gateway shows a clear success/failed/cancelled banner

items.title: Payout accounts
items.behavior: User can add/remove/set-default up to 5 bank or mobile-wallet payout accounts

items.title: Withdrawal request
items.behavior: User can submit a withdrawal with a live fee/min/max preview; blocked behind KYC with a clear path to verify

items.title: Withdrawal history
items.behavior: User sees withdrawal status history and can cancel a pending request

items.title: Withdrawal receipt
items.behavior: User can view/share a printable withdrawal receipt with the frozen conversion rate and payout amount

items.title: Referral screen
items.behavior: User sees their code/link, stat tiles, per-event reward amounts, and a list of referred people with what each earned

items.title: Claim a referrer's code post-signup
items.behavior: Claim form appears only while the server reports the user as eligible (before first purchase) and disappears after

items.title: Referral-link pre-fill
items.behavior: Opening the app via a referral link pre-fills and live-validates the code on the register screen

items.title: Compatible-phones / eSIM-support check
items.behavior: User sees the curated device list and the *#06#/EID check guide with the embedded video

items.title: eSIM setup guide
items.behavior: User sees step-by-step iOS/Android install instructions and a troubleshooting checklist

items.title: Profile screen
items.behavior: User sees their profile, can edit phone/WhatsApp, and sign out

items.title: KYC submission
items.behavior: User can submit NID number + front (required) + back (optional) photo and see Pending/Rejected status

items.title: Ticket list
items.behavior: User sees their support tickets with subject, reference, status, last-message date

items.title: New ticket
items.behavior: User can open a ticket with subject/category/body and up to 5 attachments

items.title: Ticket thread
items.behavior: User can reply with attachments and close a ticket; a resolved ticket reopens on reply

items.title: Legal documents
items.behavior: User can read Privacy/Terms/Refund/Payment/etc. documents in a tabbed view

items.title: App settings bootstrap
items.behavior: On launch the app loads public settings, languages, and currency rates before rendering money or translated strings

items.title: Maintenance mode
items.behavior: A maintenance-flagged backend shows a blocking screen instead of the app shell

items.title: Bottom tab bar
items.behavior: Explore/My eSIMs/Wallet/Refer/Profile tabs, no Agent/Partner tabs

items.title: Currency switcher
items.behavior: User can switch display currency and the choice persists via the preferences endpoint

items.title: Language switcher
items.behavior: User can switch to any admin-active language, including correct RTL layout
